about: A lightweight app for personal notes and checklists, stored as plain files.

prs.title: Checklist items with a | keep all their text
prs.broken: A checklist item with a | in it, like "Alpha | beta", showed only the first part, and the rest was deleted the next time the list was saved.
prs.changed: The app now reads the item text and its hidden details in the right order.
prs.matters: People no longer lose part of their notes just for using a | character.
